name: Grand Hyatt Taipei
insider_take: This towering luxury landmark sits atop Taipei's glittering Xinyi District, where East meets West in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Taipei boasts direct access to Taipei 101 via underground walkway, making it the ultimate base for exploring Taiwan's most iconic skyscraper. The hotel's Pearl Liang restaurant holds the distinction of serving some of the city's finest Cantonese cuisine, while the 42nd-floor Grand Club offers panoramic views of the bustling metropolis below.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 35+ for unobstructed views of Taipei 101's nightly LED light show, which transforms the tower into a dazzling spectacle visible right from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea at Cheers Bar, featuring locally-sourced oolong teas and traditional Taiwanese pastries. Just steps away, explore the vibrant Xinyi shopping district and catch the world's fastest elevator up Taipei 101 to the observation deck - all without venturing far from your luxury sanctuary.
pros: Prime location in Xinyi District with direct access to shopping and business areas
Luxurious rooms and suites with modern amenities and city views
Exceptional dining options including award-winning restaurants
Comprehensive wellness facilities with spa and fitness center
cons: Busy urban environment may not suit those seeking tranquility
